description:
A free, open source, multi-platform software designed to split, merge, extract pages, mix and rotate PDF files.


- Sejda 6.0.0.M7
- Updated translations and added Armenian
- Updated dependencies
- Added support for reading Brotli compressed streams
- Fixed sambox#253: error processing documents with malformed XMP metadata
- Fixed sejda#515: Split by bookmarks: control characters in bookmark titles no longer end up in generated file names
- Fixed sejda#265: Extract: [BASENAME] can now be used alone as output prefix
- Fixed dialogs not following the application window when moved to a second monitor
